name: jerry-skills
description: Four skills for making agents work like you would with unlimited time: mind-reading expands a few words into the full prompt you meant, using a model of you mined from your own agent history; high-agency carries tasks from intent to verified completion; iterative-improvement runs a criteria-driven adversarial loop that makes open-ended quality measurable; agent-sessions delegates work to Claude and Codex children in isolated tmux sessions.
